race.comment: FLEX FACTOR (5) has been in sparkling form recording back to back wins, the latest at Bendigo last time over 425m in (24.31). The form out of the last run is proven to be strong. Well placed and will be tough to beat. VICE LIKE GRIP (3) doesn't win out of turn. Hit the board with a minor placing last time when second (19.66) at Healesville. Can measure up. DESTINI LORENZO (1) turned in a better effort at this track last start, finishing third behind Memories (25.86) in a Grade 5. Has the early speed to land on the pace and can stick on. Must be included in calculations. BIG COOL (8) surprised many when in the placings last start - deserves some thought.
